comparability: The full-composition RMSE is an 11-type score including the malignant coordinate; the conditional RMSE is a 10-type score of a different estimand after that coordinate is withheld. They are not two measurements of one quantity and their ordering does not establish that one neighbour rule is more accurate than another.
